tables.row_grain: One recorded action referring to exactly one order category.

columns.name: history_id
columns.definition: Identifier of one order-action occurrence; separate reviews of an order have separate identifiers.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
columns.allowed_values: Integer identifier; no positive-only or business min/max CHECK is declared.

columns.name: lab_order_id
columns.definition: Laboratory order on which this action was performed, when the action concerns a laboratory request.
columns.null_meaning: The action concerns another order category; exactly one order-reference column is non-NULL.
columns.null_interpretation: Not applicable to this order category
columns.allowed_values: Existing lab_order.order_id values.

columns.name: medication_order_id
columns.definition: Medication order on which this action was performed, when the action concerns a medication request.
columns.null_meaning: The action concerns another order category; exactly one order-reference column is non-NULL.
columns.null_interpretation: Not applicable to this order category
columns.allowed_values: Existing medication_order.order_id values.

columns.name: procedure_order_id
columns.definition: Procedure order on which this action was performed, when the action concerns a procedure request.
columns.null_meaning: The action concerns another order category; exactly one order-reference column is non-NULL.
columns.null_interpretation: Not applicable to this order category
columns.allowed_values: Existing procedure_order.order_id values.

columns.name: action
columns.definition: Kind of action performed on the referenced order.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
columns.allowed_values: ENTERED, REVIEWED, CANCELLED

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.definition: Time when this particular order action occurred.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
columns.allowed_values: UTC timestamp text using the documented format; no additional date range is declared.

tables.row_grain: One laboratory measurement result, with specimen collection and result-availability times.

columns.name: labevent_id
columns.definition: Identifier of this individual laboratory measurement occurrence.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
columns.allowed_values: Integer identifier; no positive-only or business min/max CHECK is declared.

columns.name: order_id
columns.definition: Local request or prescription identifier, according to the table.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
columns.allowed_values: Existing lab_order.order_id values.

columns.name: itemid
columns.definition: Authored laboratory concept: 1001 Creatinine (mg/dL), 1002 Sodium (mmol/L), 1003 Hemoglobin (g/dL). Not original MIMIC codes.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
columns.allowed_values: 1001 = Creatinine; 1002 = Sodium; 1003 = Hemoglobin. Authored concept codes.

columns.name: charttime
columns.definition: Time when the specimen used for this laboratory measurement was collected. This column does not store measurement execution time.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
columns.allowed_values: UTC timestamp text using the documented format; no additional date range is declared.

columns.name: storetime
columns.definition: Time when this laboratory result became available in the laboratory system.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
columns.allowed_values: UTC timestamp text using the documented format; no additional date range is declared.

columns.name: valuenum
columns.definition: Numeric result recorded for this laboratory measurement.
columns.null_meaning: No numeric measurement result is recorded.
columns.unit: As specified by valueuom for the corresponding test.
columns.allowed_values: Numeric measurement value; no SQL min/max bound is declared.

columns.name: valueuom
columns.definition: Measurement unit; mg/dL for Creatinine, mmol/L for Sodium, g/dL for Hemoglobin.
columns.null_meaning: No measurement unit is specified.
columns.allowed_values: mg/dL, mmol/L or g/dL, as specified by itemid.
